Ask.waiting: Waiting for {name} to choose on their screen…
Ask.failed: {name} could not be asked. Choose for them here.
Ask.noBoardPick: Picking on the board isn't available yet: use the list.

Landing.title: Risk Legacy
Landing.heroLead: As of now there are no cities, no wars, even the continents are unnamed. But all that will change.
Landing.theWars: The wars will come. They always do.

New.title: Begin a Campaign
New.boardLead: Every war in this campaign is fought on the same board. You can't change it later.
New.boardNote: The Advanced board (JediPearce) has the same 42 territories with different continents and borders.
New.signaturePlaceholder: Your name, in your own hand
New.beginCallout: This creates the world: the board, the five factions, their First Game Power stickers, the decks, the sticker sheet and the rulebook.
New.created: Your world is ready. Next: customize the factions and the resource deck before your first game.
New.listCampaign: The campaign (the world board and the sticker sheet)
New.missingHint: Those parts of the system aren't installed yet. Run "Begin a Campaign" again later: existing documents are kept.
New.exists: This world already has a campaign. Its documents are reused; only missing ones are created.
New.noCatalog: The content catalog (data/content/base.json) could not be loaded.
New.missing: Campaign created, but these aren't available yet: {list}
New.lidText: We, the undersigned, take responsibility for the wars that are about to start, the decisions we will make, and the history we will write. Everything that is going to happen is going to happen because of us.

First.title: Before Your First Game
First.powersLead: Each faction has two possible starting powers. Choose one for each faction; the other is destroyed and never comes into play in your world.
First.pickAndDestroy: Pick one power and destroy the card.
First.coinsLead: Put the 12 coin stickers from the sticker sheet on territory cards. No card can go above 3 resources before the first game.
First.coinsNote: Three-coin territories will be hotly fought over; spreading the coins out spreads the war. Random shuffles the territory deck and puts one coin on each of the first 12 cards.
First.confirmCallout: The chosen powers go on the faction cards and the other powers are DESTROYED. The coin stickers go on the territory cards for good.
First.coinsUnused: {n} coin stickers left on the sheet.
First.readyText: Your factions and your resource deck are ready for the first war. Set up the first game when the players are here.
First.readyChat: The world is ready for its first war.

Setup.title: Setup Before Every Game
Setup.playersLead: List the players in their seats around the table, clockwise. Risk Legacy is for 3 to 5 players.
Setup.offline: not connected: the GM chooses for them
Setup.redStarToken: Red Star token (never signed the board)
Setup.countHint: {n} players: the rules are written for 3 to 5.
Setup.tokensNote: players who never signed the victors' section start with a Red Star token; the others take one Missile for every time their name is on the board.
Setup.orderLead: Everyone rolls a die. The highest roll chooses a faction first; selection then goes clockwise around the table. Ties roll again.
Setup.orderLeadDraft: Everyone rolls a die. Starting clockwise from the high roller, players draft a faction or a draft card, then the order reverses (snake draft). Ties roll again.
Setup.factionsLead: In pick order, each player chooses a faction on their own screen.
Setup.draftRulesText: Rules additions B–D are in the rulebook: factions and draft cards are drafted before every game.
Setup.draftLead: Each player drafts a faction or a draft card of a type they don't have yet, clockwise from the high roller and then back again, until everyone has a faction and one card of each type: turn order, starting placement, starting troops and starting coin cards.
Setup.noDraftCards: The draft cards aren't in the content catalog.
Setup.deployCallout: Deploying sets up the war. After this the players and their factions are fixed for this game.
Setup.deployClear: Clear last game's pieces from the board
Setup.deploySideboard: Set up the sideboard: shuffle the territory deck, lay out four cards, refill the coin pile
Setup.deployWar: Start the war (turn order, Red Star tokens and Missiles)
Setup.deployOwnership: Give each player their faction's pieces
Setup.deployScars: Deal one Scar card to each player (none if there aren't enough)
Setup.deployCoins: Deal the drafted starting coin cards
Setup.noFaction: Every player needs a faction first.
Setup.missing: Not available yet (do these by hand): {list}
Setup.bringer: {faction}, the Bringer of Nuclear Fire, receives 2 extra Missiles: the Mutants are playing.
Setup.placementLead: In placement order, each player puts their HQ and starting troops in a legal starting territory: unoccupied with no marks, or a Major City they founded. No HQ next to another HQ.
Setup.placed: {faction} starts in {territory} with {troops} troops and their HQ.
Setup.leadFaction: {faction} is the lead faction and starts with 3 troops in the World Capital ({territory}). The lead faction chooses the face-up mission.
Setup.doneLead: Written on the backs of the faction cards for game {n}:
Setup.doneAside: The player who placed first takes the first turn.

Prompt.factionLead: Choose the faction you will lead in this war.
Prompt.startHint: Your HQ and {troops} troops go here. Click a highlighted territory on the board, or choose from the list.
Prompt.draftLead: Take a faction or a draft card of a type you don't have yet.
Prompt.signLead: You won. Sign your name and date the next line on the board. Feel free to add any slogans, comments, mottos, or trash talk as appropriate.
Prompt.mottoPlaceholder: People and guns are cheap to make.
Prompt.rewardLead: Choose ONE reward. It changes this world for every war to come.
Prompt.controlledTerritory: A territory you controlled at the end
Prompt.heldOnLead: {faction} held on. Found a Minor City or upgrade a territory card, in a territory you controlled at the end of the game.
Prompt.worldLead: Fifteen wars have been fought. You signed the board the most times: this world is yours to name.
Prompt.continentAndName: Choose a continent and write its name.
Prompt.territoryAndName: Choose a territory and name the city.
Prompt.continentAndDelta: Choose a continent and a mark.
Prompt.worldName: Write the name of the world.

End.title: End of Game
End.resultsNote: If you have no troops on the board when the game ends, you are considered eliminated even if you could have joined the war on your next turn. Correct anything before confirming: the results go on the backs of the faction cards.
End.afterFifteen: After 15 games, no further changes are made to the world from winning or holding on.
End.victorLead: {name} ({faction}) signs and dates the next line on the board.
End.heldOnTitle: If you held on but did not win
End.heldOnLead: Clockwise from the winner, each faction that held on founds a Minor City or upgrades a territory card, in a territory it controlled at the end of the game.
End.worldLead: The player who signed the victors' section the most times names the planet. Tied players roll off, adding 1 for each continent they named.
End.packagesLead: These envelopes' conditions were met. Open them now, in any order you like.
End.noPackages: No envelopes to open this time. Yeah, we know that you could open them at any time you like. Just don't.
End.finish: Close the book on this war
End.packsLeft: Still sealed: {list}. Open them from the Risk Legacy page when you're ready.

Error.gmOnly: Only a Gamemaster can do that.
Error.noPackCatalog: The contents of package "{pack}" could not be loaded.
Error.unmodifiable: {territory} can no longer be marked, scarred, or modified in any way.
Error.cardMax: The {territory} card can't go above {max} resources.
Error.noMarkSpot: {territory} is a sticker on the ocean: it has no spot for a city, scar or mark.
Error.seaLineSame: A sea line connects two different territories.
Error.alienIslandPlaced: Alien Island is already on the board.
Error.badPoint: That spot isn't on the board.
Error.boardMissing: The board couldn't place the pieces: {list}
Error.cantPlace: The {sticker} sticker can't be placed from here.

Log.capitalAbout: The World Capital is about to be placed in {territory}.
Log.signed: {player} signed the victors' section for game {number}. {motto}
Log.seaLine: {by} connected {a} and {b} with a sea line.
Log.pregameCoins: Coin stickers before the first game: {list}.
Log.alienIsland: {by} placed Alien Island on the ocean.
Log.ruinCleared: The ruins of {territory}: {troops} troops removed, {hqs} HQ demolished.

Trigger.minorcities: The 9th Minor City has been founded.
Trigger.eliminated: A faction has been eliminated for the first time.
Trigger.secondwin: Someone gets to sign the board for the second time.
Trigger.worldcapital: The World Capital mark is about to go on the board.
Trigger.threemissiles: Three Missiles were used on the same combat roll. Open it BEFORE resolving combat.
Trigger.thirtytroops: Someone is about to place 30+ troops and still has a Missile. Open it before placing the troops.

Pack.title: Sealed Package
Pack.readChat: Read "The War Progresses" in chat, aloud, in order.
Pack.manualConfirm: Open {pack} now? Its contents enter the world for good.
Pack.justDont: Yeah, we know that you could open them at any time you like. Just don't.

Comeback.title: {faction}: choose a comeback power
Comeback.content: Your faction was knocked out or eliminated and has an empty blue slot. Choose its comeback power. Each faction can have only one.

MissilePower.title: {faction}: choose a Missile power
MissilePower.content: Your faction earned a Red Star token and has an empty brown slot. Choose its Missile power: once per turn, discard 1 Missile to use it.

Guided.title: To do by hand
Guided.comeback: The player controlling the eliminated faction chooses a comeback power (drag it from the package's sticker folder onto the faction card).
Guided.whoFiredThird: Which faction played the third missile?
Guided.whoCollaborates: Which faction is about to place 30+ troops (the Alien Collaborator)?
Guided.falloutHint: The player who played the third missile chooses whether the attacking or the defending territory has been nuked.
Guided.falloutPlaced: The Fallout Zone covers {territory}; its territory card is destroyed.
Guided.falloutTroops: Remove the troops in the battle, then all troops (and demolish any HQ) in the fallout territory; each territory connected to it by land loses 1 die worth of troops. Reshuffle the territory deck.
Guided.alienIsland: Alien Island wasn't placed. The Alien Collaborator can still place it (and its two sea lines) from the Sticker Sheet.
Guided.worldCapital: Place and name the World Capital in the territory of the card that would have been claimed (The world is ready).
Guided.alienIslandPlaced: Alien Island is on the board, connected by its sea lines.
Guided.alienLanding: {troops} troops landed on Alien Island (the collaborator's recruits plus 10 Alien troops).
Guided.alienEvents: Put the 7 Alien event cards aside: they go into (or create) the event deck for the next game.

AlienIsland.name: Alien Island
AlienIsland.title: Alien Island
AlienIsland.pick: Place the Alien Island sticker on any ocean
AlienIsland.pickHint: Click open water: not on land, a sea line or a printed panel. Esc cancels.
AlienIsland.numericHint: Scene coordinates of the island's centre (board {w} × {h}; the sticker is {r} px across from the centre). It must be on open water.
AlienIsland.linesLater: Alien Island doesn't have both sea lines yet: finish them from the Sticker Sheet (Alien Island sea-line start).
AlienIsland.landingText: {faction}, the Alien Collaborator, places the {reserve} troops it is getting onto Alien Island along with {aliens} Alien troops.
AlienIsland.oneFaction: For this game the Collaborator and the Aliens are one faction and the troops can be intermixed, so the Alien troops are shown as {faction} pieces.

SeaLine.pickA: Sea line: click a coastal territory
SeaLine.pickTo: Sea line to {b}: click a coastal territory
SeaLine.pickB: Sea line from {a}: click the other end
SeaLine.confirm: Connect {a} and {b} with a sea line drawn in pen.
SeaLine.forever: (They are connected in every future game.)
SeaLine.crosses: No clean route: the pen line will cross land or a printed panel.
SeaLine.noStickers: No {sticker} stickers are left on the sheet. A GM can place the line anyway from the Sticker Sheet.
SeaLine.later: The sea line wasn't drawn. The stickers are still on the sheet: place it from the Sticker Sheet.

Place.noTargets: There's nowhere this sticker can go.
Place.founderLead: Who founded it? A Major City is a legal starting territory for its founder alone.
Place.pickCity: Place the {city}: click a territory without a city
Place.capitalReplace: The World Capital replaces {city}, the mark already in the city slot of {territory}.
Place.refortify: {territory} is already fortified ({left} uses left). The new mark covers it and the remaining uses are lost.
Place.pickCancelScar: Cancel a scar: click a scarred territory
Place.ruinsConfirm: {city} in {territory} is gone for good: the ruin mark covers the city. During a war, all troops there are removed and any HQ is demolished.
Place.falloutConfirm: The Fallout Zone covers any city and scar on {territory}, and its territory card is DESTROYED (even from a hand). The territory deck is reshuffled.
Place.continentMarkLead: Placed next to a continent's bonus, forever. A continent can only be changed once.
Place.pickCoin: Coin sticker: click the territory whose card gets +1 resource (max {max})
Place.scarLead: A correction: the scar sticker goes on the board without playing a card.
Place.pickScar: {scar}: click a territory without a scar

Sheet.title: The Sticker Sheet
Sheet.heading: Sticker Sheet
Sheet.tagline: Peel one off and the world changes forever.

pending.seaLine: Waiting for {name} to draw a sea line…
pending.alienIsland: Waiting for {name} to place Alien Island…

Sheet.claimWinner: Your reward: place one of the highlighted stickers (or close this sheet and use the reward list).
Sheet.claimHeldOn: You held on: place one of the highlighted stickers (or close this sheet and use the reward list).
Sheet.overrideText: This needs {n} {sticker} sticker(s) and {left} are left on the sheet. Place it anyway (GM override)? The count stays at 0.
Sheet.scarToolHint: Put a board scar on any territory that can take one, without playing a scar card (to fix the board).
Sheet.useSheetHint: Place your reward's sticker from the Sticker Sheet instead

Rulebook.name: Risk Legacy Rulebook
Rulebook.replaced: Printed rules replaced by this sticker:
Rulebook.badLetter: "{letter}" is not a rules addition box (A–N).
Rulebook.missing: The rulebook hasn't been created yet.
Rulebook.rebuildConfirm: Delete the rulebook journal and create it again from the rules files? Rule stickers already placed are put back.
